title: TIER 3 · CELL A-3-N03
text: Something glints on the shelf above the bunk.

title: THE NUMBERS
text: 2 · 7 · 1 · 8. Someone made you learn that. Get out of the cellhouse: the rack in the ground-tier dayroom holds the trusty work keys.

title: MAINTENANCE · TOOL ISSUE
text: Cross the yard to Maintenance. The tool-issue locker wants a code you already know.

title: THE LOCKER
text: A note is taped up inside the locker.

title: GO DOWN
text: The note says pool. The card says Maintenance. The service stair at the south end of the spine goes down to B1.

title: HOLD YOUR BREATH
text: Pool, the note said. The pool annex is in Medical & Wellness; yard time starts at 14:00.

title: WHO SIGNED YOU IN
text: Administration & Intake keeps a file on every prisoner. Its staff doors take a security key. Bhosle hangs his on a hook in the tier-3 quarter and goes to lunch at 12:30.

title: SPECIAL ROOM A
text: The witness was a Dr. M. Varma. In Cellhouse B, behind glass, is a prisoner they say never forgets anything.

title: THE DRAIN
text: There's a drain grate at the deep end. Reaching it takes the whole count: 2, 7, 1, 8. Pocket the dose so the memory comes clear.

title: WHAT HOLDS IT UNDER
text: The memory stops at the grate, as if something is holding it down. The medical staff room keeps NIDRA's notes.

title: JAGRAN
text: Secure Medicine, the red-capped vial. Take it, pocket the dose, and dive for the grate again.

title: THE GRATE
text: Jagran is in you. Keep the dose in your pocket and go back down to the grate.

title: THE PATTERN
text: Whatever you find, the wall in N03 keeps it for you.

title: TONIGHT
text: Whatever you carried in, they kept. Security HQ, ground floor: Evidence / Intake. HQ doors take a security key.

title: THE RESTRICTED LIFT
text: 2 7 1 8 2 8 1 8 2 8. The lift override is 281828. NIDRA is under HQ; the cell-key storage beside the lift keeps a lab key. Surveillance, Control and Command are upstairs.

title: SUBJECT ARCHIVE
text: NIDRA keeps a tape of every cycle. The archive is behind Observation.

title: INTERROGATION A
text: The chair. This time nobody has to drag you to it.

title: OBSERVATION
text: She's behind the glass. She always has been.

title: KABIR
text: You said it. Kabir is still behind the glass in Cellhouse B; the cell master key is kept in HQ Command.

title: THE GHOST EXIT
text: Everything here drains to the old reservoir. Maintenance B1: the gated landing, the sump, the culvert under the wall. Bhosle's card opens the landing.

title: EIGHT
text: Hold on, or let go.
